info.title: Mobile Money Bridge API
info.description:
API for bridging mobile money providers (MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Orange Money) with the Stellar blockchain network.

Enables low-cost cross-border payments and remittances across Africa by connecting mobile money wallets to Stellar's decentralized network.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a JWT bearer token obtained via `POST /api/auth/login`:
```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Admin endpoints require an API key:
```
X-API-Key: <key>
```

## Key Concepts

- **Deposit**: Mobile money fiat (XAF, XOF, etc.) → Stellar tokens (USDC, XLM)
- **Withdraw**: Stellar tokens → Mobile money fiat in the destination country
- **Settlement**: Stellar network handles cross-border settlement in ~5 seconds at minimal cost
- **KYC**: Tiered identity verification (Unverified, Basic, Full) determines daily transaction limits

bearerAuth.description:
JWT Bearer token obtained via `POST /api/auth/login`.

Include as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

Tokens expire after 24 hours. Use `POST /api/auth/refresh` with a valid refresh token to obtain a new access token without re-authenticating.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description:
API key for admin-level operations.

Include as: `X-API-Key: <key>`

Admin API keys are generated via the admin dashboard. They grant full access to admin endpoints including user management, system configuration, and transaction oversight.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned on failed API requests.

error.description: Machine-readable error code or short description.

message.example: Amount must be a positive number

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page.

offset.description: Offset from the start of the result set.

total.description: Total number of items matching the query (for offset pagination).

hasMore.description: Whether more results are available (for cursor pagination).

TransactionRequest.description:
Request payload to initiate a mobile money deposit or withdrawal.

Amount is in the local fiat currency (XAF). Provider must match the phone number's network.

amount.description:
Transaction amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., XAF — no decimals).

Minimum: 100 XAF (anti-spam)
Maximum: 1,000,000 XAF per transaction (fraud prevention)

phoneNumber.description: Mobile money phone number in E.164 format (+237670000000) or local format. Must match the selected provider's network.

provider.description:
Target mobile money provider.

- **mtn**: MTN MoMo (Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Ghana, etc.)
- **airtel**: Airtel Money (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, etc.)
- **orange**: Orange Money (Guinea, Madagascar, etc.)

stellarAddress.description: Destination Stellar public key (starts with 'G'). Must be a valid ed25519 Stellar account. The user must trust the anchor's issued asset before receiving tokens.

userId.description: The authenticated user's UUID. Inferred from the JWT token for standard requests; may be explicitly set for admin-initiated transactions.

notes.description: Optional human-readable memo or reference for the transaction. Appears in transaction history and invoice. Max 256 characters.

TransactionResponse.description: Response returned after successfully initiating a deposit or withdrawal request.

success.description: Indicates whether the request was accepted for processing. 'true' means the transaction has been queued.

transactionId.description: Unique transaction identifier (UUID v4). Use this ID with GET /api/transactions/{id} to check status.

referenceNumber.description:
Human-readable reference number for customer support.

Format: TXN-YYYYMMDD-NNN (deposits), WTH-YYYYMMDD-NNN (withdrawals).

status.description: Initial status. New transactions start as 'pending' and advance to 'processing' once submitted to the mobile money provider.

provider.description: Mobile money provider handling this transaction.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the transaction was created on the server.

TransactionDetail.description: Full detail of a single transaction, including Stellar on-chain reference when the transaction completes.

referenceNumber.description: Human-readable reference number assigned by the system upon creation.

type.description:
Direction of the transaction relative to Stellar.

- **deposit**: Mobile money fiat → Stellar tokens (user sends mobile money, receives Stellar assets)
- **withdraw**: Stellar tokens → Mobile money fiat (user sends Stellar assets, receives mobile money)

status.description: Current lifecycle status. Terminal (final) states: completed, failed, cancelled.

amount.description: Transaction amount in the local currency.

fee.description: Processing fee deducted from the amount. Populated after fee calculation. Fee varies by provider, KYC tier, and VIP status.

provider.description: Mobile money provider handling this transaction.

phoneNumber.description: Mobile money phone number associated with the transaction.

stellarAddress.description: Stellar account address involved in the transfer.

stellarTransactionHash.description: Stellar network transaction hash (64 hex chars). Populated once the on-chain Stellar operation completes. Use this to look up the transaction on Stellar Explorer.

notes.description: User-provided memo or reference attached to this transaction.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached by the caller. Common use cases: internal reference IDs, category tagging, invoice linking.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the transaction was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent status update.

RegisterRequest.description: Registration payload for a new user account.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format. This will serve as the user's login identifier.

password.description:
Password with strong security requirements.

Minimum 12 characters. Must include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one special character. Will be hashed with bcrypt before storage.

LoginRequest.description: Login credentials. Returns JWT access token + refresh token on success.

LoginResponse.description: Successful authentication response containing JWT tokens.

token.description: JWT access token. Valid for 24 hours. Include in subsequent requests as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

refreshToken.description: Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens without re-authenticating. Valid for 30 days. Store securely.

email.description: User's phone number (used as email-like identifier).

role.description: RBAC role assigned to this user.

permissions.description: Array of permission strings for fine-grained access control.

CreateVaultRequest.description: Request to create a new savings vault. Vaults hold Stellar assets and earn yield.

name.description: User-defined name for the vault (e.g., "Education Fund", "Emergency Savings"). Must be unique per user.

targetCurrency.description: Target Stellar asset for the vault. Common values: USDC (stablecoin), XLM (native).

goalAmount.description: Optional savings goal amount. Used for progress tracking in the UI.

VaultTransferRequest.description: Request to deposit funds into or withdraw funds from a savings vault.

amount.description: Amount to transfer. Must be positive. Cannot exceed vault balance for withdrawals.

direction.description:
Direction of the transfer relative to the vault.

- **deposit**: Move funds from the user's main balance into the vault
- **withdraw**: Move funds from the vault back to the user's main balance

SubmitKycSchema.description: KYC document submission payload. Accepts document images for identity verification.

documentType.description: Type of identity document being submitted.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of document issuance.

WebhookPayload.description:
Payload delivered to registered webhook endpoints when transaction events occur.

Webhooks are sent via POST with HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Webhook-Signature header for verification.

event_type.description: The type of event that triggered this webhook.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

amount.description: Transaction amount as a decimal string.

get.description: Returns 200 OK if the server process is alive. Does NOT check database or Redis connectivity. Use /ready for a full dependency check.
Returns 200 OK only when PostgreSQL and Redis connections are healthy. Returns 503 if any dependency is unreachable.
Lightweight health check for load balancers. Returns plain text 'ok' with minimal overhead. No database queries.

post.description: Creates a new user account with phone number and password. The phone number must be unique. After registration, the user can log in via POST /api/auth/login to receive JWT tokens.

201.description: User registered successfully. The userId will be used to identify the user in subsequent operations.

400.description: Validation error — invalid phone number format, weak password, or missing required fields.

409.description: Conflict — phone number is already registered.

post.description:
Authenticates with phone number and password. Returns a JWT access token and a refresh token on success.

The access token must be included in subsequent requests as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

Access tokens expire after 24 hours. Use POST /api/auth/refresh with the refresh token to obtain a new access token.

200.description: Login successful. Returns JWT tokens and user info.

401.description: Invalid credentials — phone number not found or password incorrect.

429.description: Account locked due to too many consecutive failed login attempts. Try again later or contact support.

post.summary: Rotate refresh token and issue new access token
post.description:
Uses a valid refresh token to obtain a new JWT access token and a new refresh token. This allows long-lived sessions without requiring the user to re-enter credentials.

The old refresh token is invalidated after successful rotation (token rotation pattern). Refresh tokens expire after 30 days of inactivity.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token received from POST /api/auth/login or a previous POST /api/auth/refresh call.

200.description: Token rotation successful. Returns new access token and refresh token.

token.description: New JWT access token (valid for 24 hours).

refreshToken.description: New refresh token (previous one is invalidated).

get.summary: Get current authenticated user profile and balance
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile information including their role, permissions, and current balance. Requires a valid JWT bearer token.

role.description: RBAC role: user, admin, support, etc.

total_deposited.description: Lifetime total deposited amount as a decimal string.

total_withdrawn.description: Lifetime total withdrawn amount as a decimal string.

current_balance.description: Current available balance as a decimal string.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid JWT token.

post.summary: Initiate a mobile money deposit to Stellar
post.description:
Converts mobile money fiat (XAF, XOF, etc.) into Stellar tokens (USDC, XLM). The user sends mobile money from their phone, and the equivalent value in Stellar assets is credited to their Stellar account.

Transaction limits depend on the user's KYC tier:
- Unverified: 10,000 XAF/day
- Basic (ID + selfie): 100,000 XAF/day
- Full (proof of address + video): 1,000,000 XAF/day

400.description: Validation error, provider limit exceeded, or insufficient KYC tier.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid JWT token.

post.summary: Initiate a Stellar withdrawal to mobile money
post.description:
Converts Stellar tokens (USDC, XLM) back into mobile money fiat. The user's Stellar balance is debited and the equivalent value is sent to their mobile money wallet.

This operation requires 2FA (TOTP) to be enabled on the account.

400.description: Validation error, insufficient balance, or limit exceeded.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid JWT token.

get.summary: List transactions with pagination and filters
get.description: Returns a paginated list of transactions for the authenticated user. Supports cursor-based and offset-based pagination. Filterable by status, type, provider, and date range.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (1-100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of transactions to skip (offset-based pagination).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor for backward pagination. Returns transactions created before this cursor ID.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for forward pagination. Returns transactions created after this cursor ID.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid JWT token.

get.summary: Get a single transaction by ID
get.description: Returns full details of a specific transaction, including its current status, Stellar transaction hash (if completed), and any associated metadata.

404.description: Transaction not found or does not belong to the authenticated user.

get.summary: Download a completed transaction invoice as PDF
get.description:
Generates and downloads a PDF invoice for a completed transaction. The invoice includes transaction details, fees, exchange rate, and a QR code for verification.

Only available for transactions with status 'completed'. Returns 400 for transactions in any other state.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Set to '0' to display the PDF inline in the browser instead of triggering a download.

400.description: Invoice only available for completed transactions.

post.description: Cancels a transaction that is still in 'pending' status. Cannot cancel transactions already in 'processing', 'completed', or other terminal states.

400.description: Cannot cancel transaction in current state.

post.summary: Open a dispute for a transaction
post.description:
Opens a formal dispute for a completed transaction. Disputes are reviewed by support agents and may result in a reversal or uphold decision.

Required: The transaction must be in 'completed' status and the dispute must be opened within 90 days of completion.

reason.description: The reason for opening the dispute.
reason.example: Amount not credited to mobile money wallet

200.description: Dispute opened successfully. A support agent will review the case.

400.description: Transaction cannot be disputed (not completed, or outside dispute window).

patch.description: Updates the notes/memo attached to a transaction. Replaces any existing notes. Max 256 characters.

notes.description: New notes text. Overwrites any existing notes.
notes.example: Updated payment note: rent for March

put.description: Replaces all metadata on a transaction with the provided key-value pairs. Existing metadata is completely overwritten.

metadata.description: New metadata to attach. All existing keys will be removed.

patch.description: Merges the provided metadata into the transaction's existing metadata. New keys are added, existing keys are overwritten, and keys not in the request are preserved.

metadata.description: Key-value pairs to merge into existing metadata.

delete.summary: Delete specific metadata keys from a transaction
delete.description: Removes specific keys from the transaction's metadata. Keys that do not exist are silently ignored.

keys.description: Array of metadata key names to remove.

post.description: Creates a new goal-based savings vault. Vaults hold Stellar assets and allow users to set savings goals, track progress, and earn yield on deposited funds.

409.description: A vault with this name already exists.

get.summary: List all vaults for the authenticated user
get.description: Returns all savings vaults belonging to the authenticated user, with current balances and goal progress.

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: If 'true', includes vaults that have been deactivated or fully withdrawn.

get.summary: Get aggregated balance summary across all vaults
get.description: Returns the total balance and vault count aggregated across all of the user's savings vaults.

post.summary: Deposit or withdraw funds from a vault
post.description: Moves funds between the user's main balance and a savings vault. Deposits add funds to the vault; withdrawals move funds back to the main balance.

403.description: Access denied — vault does not belong to the authenticated user.

post.summary: Enable TOTP 2FA for the authenticated user
post.description:
Enables time-based one-time password (TOTP) two-factor authentication using the Speakeasy library. Returns a QR code URI that the user can scan with any authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.).

Once enabled, 2FA is required for all withdrawal operations.

200.description: 2FA setup initiated. Returns the TOTP secret and QR code URI.

qrCodeUri.description: otpauth:// URI for QR code generation.

post.summary: Submit KYC documents for identity verification
post.description:
Submits identity documents for KYC verification. The uploaded documents are stored securely in S3 and forwarded to the verification provider (Entrust).

KYC tiers:
- Basic: National ID or Passport + selfie
- Full: Proof of address + video verification

Higher KYC tiers unlock higher daily transaction limits.

documentImage.description: Image file of the document (JPEG, PNG, or PDF).

200.description: KYC documents submitted. Verification in progress.

400.description: Invalid document or missing required fields.

get.description: Returns the current KYC verification status and tier level for the authenticated user.
Returns the native XLM balance and all asset balances for a Stellar account. Results are cached for 5 minutes to reduce Horizon load.

balance.description: XLM balance as a decimal string.

balanceStroops.description: XLM balance in stroops (1 XLM = 10^7 stroops).

cached.description: Whether the result was served from cache.

404.description: Stellar account not found on the network or not yet funded.

post.description:
GraphQL endpoint supporting queries, mutations, and real-time subscriptions.

See the GraphQL playground at /graphql in development mode for schema exploration and interactive query building.

200.description: GraphQL response (may contain errors or data).

get.description: Exposes application metrics in Prometheus text format. Includes transaction counts, response times, queue depths, error rates, and provider availability metrics.

200.description: Prometheus metrics in plain text format.

get.description: Access the BullMQ admin dashboard for monitoring job queues, retrying failed jobs, and inspecting queue metrics. Requires admin API key.
Returns reconciliation data comparing internal transaction records with mobile money provider statements. Used for financial auditing and discrepancy detection.
Returns aggregate transaction statistics including volume, counts by status, provider breakdowns, and time-series data.
Exports all personal data associated with the authenticated user in a machine-readable JSON format. Complies with GDPR Article 20 (right to data portability).

200.description: Personal data export in JSON format.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated personal data. Complies with GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure).

This action is irreversible. Transaction records are anonymized (not deleted) to maintain financial audit trails.

200.description: Account and personal data deletion initiated.

message.example: Account deletion initiated. Data will be fully removed within 30 days.
